events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Hynde's Enduring Influence
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude shaped generations. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's his most iconic moment for you?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day marks the 1962 premiere of 'Dr. No', the first film in the iconic 007 franchise.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, what's your ultimate 007 moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering The Beatles' co-founder John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of John Lennon. Which of his songs resonates most with you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Cleese's Comic Genius
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From 'Monty Python' to 'Fawlty Towers', what's your favourite moment of his comedic genius?

events.title: Freddie Mercury Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the extraordinary talent of Queen's frontman, Freddie Mercury, on the anniversary of his passing in 1991.

angles.name: Tribute to Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost him, but Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' in the UK on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Impact
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that changed pop music forever. What's your favourite track from it?
